0.title: Classical Machine Learning
0.content: This section covers foundational and advanced classical machine learning algorithms, mathematical formulations, optimization techniques, and evaluation frameworks.

1.title: Key Focus Areas
1.content: . | Supervised Learning: Linear/Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Decision Trees, Ensemble Methods (Random Forests, Gradient Boosting). | Unsupervised Learning: K-Means Clustering, PCA, Dimensionality Reduction. | Model Evaluation & Validation: Bias-Variance tradeoff, cross-validation, evaluation metrics. | .

2.title: Natural Language Processing
2.content: This section documents text representation, sequence modeling, attention mechanisms, and Large Language Model (LLM) architectures.

3.title: Key Focus Areas
3.content: . | Text Representations: Tokenization, Word2Vec, GloVe, subword embeddings. | Sequence Modeling: Encoder-Decoder models, attention mechanisms, Transformer architecture. | LLMs & Fine-Tuning: Prompt engineering, PEFT/LoRA, instruction tuning, and alignment techniques. | .

4.title: Computer Vision
4.content: This section covers visual perception models, image processing fundamentals, spatial transformations, and modern deep-learning-based vision pipelines.

5.title: Key Focus Areas
5.content: . | Core Operations: Image filtering, convolutions, feature extraction. | High-Level Tasks: Image classification, object detection (YOLO, R-CNN), semantic and instance segmentation. | Representation Learning: Vision Transformers (ViTs), contrastive learning, and self-supervised visual models. | .

6.title: Recommender Systems
6.content: This section focuses on personalized ranking models, collaborative filtering, candidate generation, and industrial-scale recommendation pipelines.

7.title: Key Focus Areas
7.content: . | Collaborative & Content-Based Filtering: Matrix factorization, SVD, implicit feedback models. | Deep Learning for RecSys: Two-tower models, sequential recommendation, graph neural networks for recommendations. | Serving & Evaluation: Retrieval vs. ranking stages, offline metrics (NDCG, MAP), online AB testing metrics. | .

8.title: ML Engineering
8.content: This section covers operational practices (MLOps), deployment infrastructure, model monitoring, and software engineering best practices for ML codebases.

9.title: Key Focus Areas
9.content: . | MLOps & Orchestration: CI/CD for machine learning, pipeline orchestration (Kubeflow, Airflow). | Model Deployment: Containerization (Docker), Triton Inference Server, ONNX runtime optimization, edge deployment. | Monitoring & Governance: Data quality monitoring, concept drift detection, model explainability. | .

10.title: Deep Learning
10.content: This section explores neural network architectures, training dynamics, loss landscapes, and optimization algorithms from first principles.

11.title: Key Focus Areas
11.content: . | Core Architecture: Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs), backpropagation, activation functions. | Optimization & Regularization: Gradient descent variants, batch normalization, dropout, weight decay. | Advanced Topologies: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), LSTMs, Transformers, and modern generative architectures. | .

12.title: ML System Design
12.content: This section translates theoretical machine learning models into robust, scalable, and production-ready architectures for real-world use cases.

13.title: Key Focus Areas
13.content: . | Problem Formulation: Translating business metrics into ML objectives. | Data & Feature Pipelines: Real-time vs. batch feature stores, handling data drift and skew. | Scalability & Trade-offs: Latency, throughput, storage constraints, and cost optimization for inference. | .

14.title: AIML(0-to-100): AI & ML Knowledge Base
14.content: Welcome to My AI & ML Knowledge Base (aiml-0-to-100). You can explore notes organized by category, tracking concepts from foundations up to systems and frameworks. The goal is to enable rigorous first-principles thinking, clean formulations, and continuous technical sharpening.
